subject: Supplier registration – printed laminates and cartons
body:
Dear Procurement Team,

I am the Director of Al-Noor Packaging (Pvt) Ltd, Lahore. We have converted printed laminates and folding cartons for food brands for 18 years and are FSSC 22000 and BRCGS certified.

We would like to be considered as a packaging supplier for your biscuit lines. Our website is alnoorpack.com.pk. Please let me know what you need from us to start registration.

Regards,
Imran Siddiqui
Al-Noor Packaging (Pvt) Ltd
+92 42 3576 1180

subject: Wheat flour supply – Chenab Flour Mills, Faisalabad
body:
Assalam o Alaikum,

Chenab Flour Mills has been milling since 2001 and supplies fine flour and maida to bakeries and biscuit makers across Punjab. We understand you may be adding a flour source near Faisalabad.

We can offer 2,500 tonnes per month with 30 day terms. Kindly share your vendor onboarding requirements.

Khalid Javed
General Manager Sales
Chenab Flour Mills

subject: Cocoa powder best price
body:
Hi,

We import natural and alkalised cocoa powder from Malaysia and Ivory Coast. Best rates in Karachi, ready stock. We work on advance payment only because of LC issues. Can deliver 10 tonnes this week.

WhatsApp me for rates.
Adnan
Seaview Cocoa & Commodities

subject: Bakery shortening and palm olein – new supplier
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Sunrise Edible Oils (Pvt) Ltd, Sheikhupura, manufactures bakery shortening, margarine and palm olein. We are ISO 22000 and PSQCA Halal certified and supply several snack companies.

We heard EBM is looking for a second shortening source and would be pleased to submit samples.

Best regards,
Saad Tariq
Business Development, Sunrise Edible Oils

subject: Logistics partnership – Karachi to Lahore line haul
body:
Hello,

SwiftHaul Logistics runs 140 owned trucks on the Karachi–Lahore corridor and 2 bonded warehouses at Port Qasim. We move FMCG cargo for several food and beverage companies.

We would like to register as a carrier for EBM's peak season. Our company profile is at swifthaul.pk.

Regards,
Rabia Khan
Key Accounts, SwiftHaul Logistics

subject: Broken biscuits in a family pack
body:
Hello,

I bought a family pack from a store in Rawalpindi yesterday and almost half the biscuits were broken. Batch number on the pack is 2610B. Is this a known issue? I would like a replacement.

Thanks,
Hira
